einzeiler: A 5-minute meditation practice to activate your intuition and inner wisdom.
kurzfassung: This episode features a five-minute community mini meditation designed to activate your intuition. Kelly introduces the featured organization, Bluebirds and Blooms, which brings recycled flowers to care communities. Listeners are then guided through a calming breathing exercise and visualization to clear their minds and connect with their inner guidance.
stichpunkte: Introduction of the monthly community mini supporting Bluebirds and Blooms
Overview of how the organization delivers recycled flowers to nursing homes and hospice care around the Twin Cities
Transition into a five-minute intuition activation meditation
Physical grounding through a long spine and relaxed shoulders
Breathwork signaling the body and mind to slow down and turn inward
Shifting awareness away from external opinions and expectations
Focusing on the space between the eyebrows as the gateway to intuition
Visualization of cleaning a glass window and igniting a bright inner light

clips.hook: Supporting care communities with recycled flowers
clips.text: The host discusses a favored local organization that repurposes donated flowers from grocery stores and arranges them for residents in hospice and nursing facilities throughout the Twin Cities.

clips.hook: Slowing down with a deep breath
clips.text: Listeners are instructed to take a deep inhalation through the nose and a slow expiration through the mouth to signal physical and mental relaxation.

beschreibung:
Activate your intuition, and clean the window to your inner wisdom with this 6 minute guided meditation. This practice is a short activation to bring awareness to your intuition, so it can be stronger throughout your day.

This is a community mini- all ad revenue generated on this episode in August will be donated to Bluebirds and Blooms which is an organization that brings donated flowers to those who are in care facilities in the Twin Cities.
